summary.text: Edwin Obras is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 33-Position 1, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Chris Martinez.

paragraphs.text: Edwin Obras earned a B.A. in American Ethnic Studies from the University of Washington and a master's in public administration from Northeastern University.

From 2008 to 2024, he served in the Human Services Department for the City of Seattle in roles including deputy division director, budget and policy director, and contracts manager, and he has also served as board president of the Filipino Community of Seattle.
The King County Council appointed Obras to the Washington House of Representatives District 33-Position 1 on December 11, 2024, to replace Tina Orwall.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary with 70.8 percent of the vote.
